name: PoliticsBench
description: While Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as primary sources of information, their potential for political bias may impact their objectivity. Existing benchmarks of LLM social bias primarily evaluate demographic stereotypes, and when political bias is measured, it is done so at a coarse level, overlooking the values that shape sociopolitical reasoning. We introduce PoliticsBench, a multi-stage roleplay benchmark for evaluating fine-grained value expression in LLMs.
